title: rigops config
description: Configuration for rigops. All paths accept ~ and $VAR expansion.

transcripts_dir.description: Root directory of Claude Code project transcripts.

ledger.description: Settings for the rigops ledger (weekly effectiveness rows).

watch_projects.description: Map of project name to its transcripts sub-path, watched by the ledger.

fixed_tax.description: Always-loaded config counted toward the fixed context tax.

paths.description: Explicit file paths counted toward the fixed tax.

globs.description: Glob patterns counted toward the fixed tax.

context.description: Settings for the plugin's context-nudge hook and statusline.

nudge_tiers.description: Ascending context-token thresholds (low/heavy/critical) that trigger the ctx-nudge hook and color the statusline.

rearm_tokens.description: Token climb, past the lowest tier, required to re-fire the ctx-nudge hook.

doctor.description: Settings for `rigops doctor` (job fleet health watchdog).

registry.description: Path to the rigops.v1 registry markdown file.

label_prefix.description: Launchd label prefixes tried, in order, when a registry item has no explicit plist.

kill_grace_s.description: Seconds to wait after SIGTERM before SIGKILL on a hung job.

heal_cooldown_h.description: Hours to suppress a repeat kickstart of the same job after healing it.

checks.description: Generic fleet-wide checks, independent of the registry.

custom.description: Shell commands checked by exit code.

disk_free.description: Disk-free threshold check, or null to skip it.

notify_command.description: Shell command run with the report path appended; empty to skip notifications.

roots.description: Projects trees scanned for repositories (primary checkouts two levels under each root).

sessions_dir.description: Directory of live-session JSON files ({"pid": N, "cwd": "..."}); a worktree claimed by a live session is never touched. Missing directory disables this extra guard.

grace_days.description: An unmerged branch with no unpushed commits becomes eligible once its tip commit is older than this many days.

max_kills_per_tree.description: More matched processes than this under one worktree means the match is not trusted: no signals, no removal.

orphan_min_age_s.description: Minimum elapsed runtime before a launchd-reparented build daemon counts as orphaned.

kill_grace_s.description: Seconds between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when clearing processes out of a reapable worktree.

ignored_untracked_dirs.description: Untracked path segments treated as regenerated build output, never work in progress.

ignored_untracked_prefixes.description: Untracked path-segment prefixes treated as regenerated build output.

rules.description: Hygiene rules, applied in order. Read-only unless the run passes --apply.

path.description: Base file or directory the rule operates on.

glob.description: Filename pattern matched against entries under path; matched against entry names only, patterns containing '/' match nothing.

older_than_days.description: Only entries whose mtime is older than this many days match.

max_depth.description: How many directory levels below path are searched; omit for unlimited.

action.description: delete removes matches; truncate keeps the last keep_lines of a file; keep_newest_n deletes all but the newest keep matches; report only lists matches; command runs a shell command under --apply.

only_empty.description: With dirs, match only empty directories.

keep_lines.description: Line count kept by the truncate action (default 500).

command.description: Shell command for the command action.

watermarks.description: Size watermarks; a tripped watermark appends a deduplicated line to the backlog.

path.description: Directory or glob over directories to measure.

area.description: Backlog area used for the appended line (default memory).

max_delete.description: A rule matching more deletions than this is skipped whole; the match is not trusted. Counts files; a directory candidate counts as one plus every file under it.

areas.description: Allowed area tags in backlog lines.

sources.description: External CLIs mined for ledger row annotations (`row.sources`).

rtk.description: external CLI mined for ledger annotation; absent tool = null annotation, never an error

argv.description: Argument vector for the rtk CLI call.

ccusage.description: external CLI mined for ledger annotation; absent tool = null annotation, never an error

argv.description: Argument vector for the ccusage CLI call.

custom.description: Arbitrary JSON-emitting CLIs, each annotated onto the ledger row under its name. reserved names rtk and ccusage are ignored; custom sources run on every ledger write including --dry-run, so give them read-only commands.

authprobe.description: Settings for `rigops authprobe` (headless credential probe spawns the real CLI; ships disabled). Wire it from doctor via checks.custom: rigops authprobe.

enabled.description: ships disabled; headless credential probe spawns the real CLI

command.description: Argument vector run under a scrubbed environment.

path.description: PATH for the scrubbed probe env

keychain_service.description: macOS keychain service name holding a long-lived token; empty = skip keychain
